step.prompt: A single soft footstep on damp stone in a dungeon, short, close, no music

place.prompt: A heavy stone tile slid into place on a stone floor, short low thud and scrape, no music

crumble.prompt: Old stone floor cracking and collapsing into a deep pit, rocks tumbling down into darkness, no music

fall.prompt: A body falling into a bottomless abyss, rushing air whoosh fading away, distant faint impact, no music

monster.prompt: A horrifying wet growl and shriek of a creature lunging out of darkness, clawing swipe, no music

extinguish.prompt: A candle flame blown out, soft puff and a faint hiss of smoke, quiet, no music

relight.prompt: A match striking and a candle wick igniting with a soft warm whoosh, no music

key.prompt: An old iron key picked up from stone, short metallic jingle, no music

resolve.prompt: One deep slow heartbeat thump with soft dark reverb, no music

flicker.prompt: A dying candle flame sputtering and crackling, with a low ominous drone swelling underneath

win.prompt: A huge iron gate creaking open, chains rattling, then a warm hopeful choir chord rising

lose.prompt: A deep ominous drone and cold wind howling as darkness falls, sorrowful low strings fading out

ambient.prompt: Dark underground dungeon ambience: slow water drips echoing, distant low rumble, faint wind through stone corridors, no music, no melody

menu.prompt: Dark ambient instrumental, slow solo cello over low drones and distant choir, candlelit dungeon, melancholic and mysterious, sparse
